text:
Sam (People Ops): quick manager tool — one-line feedback + short sync template. pasteable, small, and designed for busy 1:1s.

Sam (People Ops): ONE-LINERS (use as first sentence in review notes)
- Exceeded:
  - "Delivered X ahead of schedule; scaled to Y users with <Z% error — great operational ownership."
- On-track: 
  - "Made steady progress on A; unblocked B work and improved reliability."
- Missed but learned:
  - "Didn't meet Goal X due to infra constraints; documented lessons and proposed a clearer rollback plan."
- Growth signal:
  - "Demonstrated coaching on the team and stepped up to lead post-release incident analysis."

Sam (People Ops): SHORT SYNC TEMPLATE (manager sends to direct 48h before review meeting)
- Subject: Quick prep for self-review sync (20m)
- Body (paste):
  - Hi <name>,
  - Can you drop two bullets in this thread before our 20m sync?
    1) Top outcome you owned this cycle (+ numbers if possible).
    2) One thing you want me to do next cycle to help you.
  - I'll bring 1 manager highlight + 1 area to unblock. See you at <time>.
  - Thanks — <manager>

Dana (Eng Manager): love the subject/body. adding a calibration note for managers: keep the first manager highlight specific & evidence-backed (link PR, metric, or customer).

Luis (IC): can we add a micro-template for "dependency caused miss"? teammates keep apologizing without context.

Sam (People Ops): sure — DEPENDENCY EXPLAINER (one line)
- "Goal X delayed due to Y (owner: team Z); impact on timeline and mitigation: we added a temporary shim and scheduled a joint release with Z."

Taylor (Recruiter): quick ask: can managers include a hiring signal in reviews? one line is fine.

Sam (People Ops): HIRING SIGNAL (one line example)
- "Recommend hiring: 1 Sr SRE to complete autoscaler work (reason: single-threaded limit causing rollout stalls)."

Sam (People Ops): MINI CHECKLIST for the review meeting (20m)
- 0-3m: confirm the two bullets the IC posted.
- 3-10m: manager highlight + evidence.
- 10-16m: discuss one blocker and owner/next steps.
- 16-20m: one growth ask & agree on 2 actions.

Dana (Eng Manager): im saving this as a reusable snippet in my calendar invite. can you also post a tiny Notion copy/paste page?

Sam (People Ops): will do; I'll pin in #people-ops-templates and add a variant for PMs and ICs that want product wording.

Luis (IC): thanks — these are actually short enough to use. :rocket:
